decision.question: how to detect a heartbeat/task-loop escalation with no tag recorded on the line
options: add a system/caller field threaded through Cards.js's ask()
detect by the two callers' exact option pairs and phrases
decision.why: Cards.js's tool() wrapper already drops the caller context before ask() ever sees it; changing that write path is bigger surgery than a quick fix should do, and the two callers' wording is stable (one-line functions nobody edits casually)

log.msg: found the real bug behind 'the rail reorders live': flush() ALWAYS forced a reorder (draw_groups(true)) on every quiet paint, not just when a row was genuinely new — a headless proof caught this (same order before/after claimed true the first pass, but only because quiet() was coincidentally false in an interactive browser; a headless one has no real pointer, so quiet() was always true and exposed it). Fixed: flush() only forces when a row is new or removed.

found the tab-alignment bug: .ai2-tab-needs/.ai2-tab-inbox/.ai2-tab-overview each got an explicit CSS order, which also reordered tabs.css's own .tab-bar::after (the trailing spacer) to the front at its default order:0 — it absorbed the row's leftover width FIRST and shoved the real tabs to the far right edge. Fixed with one rule, .ai2-head .tab-bar::after { order: 5 }.

finding 2 (Log should group minions under their task, collapsed): declined as written, confirmed as satisfied — groups.tasks is already one row per TASK FOLDER, so there is nothing to collapse: no minion ever had its own row to begin with. finding 3 (updated pill covers the Live row): fixed — moved $updated into .ai2-rows as its own sticky-in-flow child (same pattern as the Log tab's pill) instead of position:absolute floating over the rows; the row below it is pushed down, never hidden.

The sender-tagging suggestion is logged as a real future improvement (see the next line) but is bigger than this quick fix: Cards.js's tool() wrapper drops every caller's context before ask() ever sees it, so tagging it means changing that write path, not just the read side.

deferred, for a future task: thread the caller (servex-task-loop / servex-heartbeat) through Cards.js's ask() into the place line itself, so is_task_loop_escalation() can check a field instead of matching text and two known option pairs.
